name: Feta Tomato Pasta
directions: Put feta cheese in the middle of a glass baking dish and surround with the cherry tomatoes and garlic
Coat the ingredients with oil, salt, pepper, paprika and black pepper
Bake for about 25-30 minutes. While the sauce is baking, cook pasta according to instructions on the box and drain and set aside
Once out of the oven, smush tomatoes, garlic and feta and mix well. Or place everything into a blender and blend until smooth.
Add the cooked pasta into the mixture and serve.
